title: Victory Over Sin
definition: Victory over sin is the believer's Spirit-empowered freedom from sin's ruling power through union with Christ.
summary: Believers still battle sin, but they are no longer slaves to it. Grace trains them to say no to ungodliness.
christFocus: Christ broke sin's dominion and gives His people power to walk in obedience.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Believers still battle sin, but they are no longer slaves to it. Grace trains them to say no to ungodliness.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, follow Christ faithfully, and avoid confusion in doctrine and daily life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
